Sam drinks coffee every morning. The supermarket is not far from my home. Sam and Mia are in the same class. Also, I take off my shoes at the door.
The supermarket is my favorite place. Mia often helps me with math. After school, we play together. What's more, we dug up fresh potatoes.
We talk about math a lot. My friend Mia is very kind. Sam's favorite season is autumn.
